screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Start Flenting' button is a floating action button at the bottom of the screen. It should be absolutely positioned relative to the screen container, with a 57px gap from the bottom and 40px horizontal margins on each side.

layoutIssues.figmaValue: A single Text element with nested, colored Text elements
layoutIssues.explanation: The header 'Let’s get you set up' is a single conceptual text block where 'you set up' is a different color. This must be implemented using nested <Text> components within a single parent <Text> to ensure correct line wrapping and styling, rather than using two separate Text components which would break the flow.

feedback.explanation: The screen background is missing the linear gradient overlay on top of the background image. This is essential for blending the image and ensuring header text is readable. The gradient should fade from transparent to the screen's base color (`colors.black[700]`).

The header text 'Let’s get you set up' has multiple colors but is a single line in Figma. It must be implemented using a single parent <Text> with a nested <Text> for the highlighted portion to ensure correct wrapping and styling. This is a structural requirement from Figma data.

The 'Start Flenting →' button must be absolutely positioned at the bottom of the screen with specific margins. Its background color is also incorrect. This combines a structural color mismatch with a screen-level layout issue.
feedback.fixedCode:
button: {
  position: 'absolute',
  bottom: 57,
  left: 40,
  right: 40,
  backgroundColor: theme.colors.black[500], // was #202020
}

feedback.explanation: The vertical spacing between major screen elements is incorrect. The header requires a large top margin (124px), and the gap between the header, card carousel, and pagination dots needs to be adjusted to 30px.

Text elements with multiple styles, like '₹ 32,175' and 'Add your landlord’s bank details...', must be rendered as a single <Text> component with nested <Text> spans for different colors. This is a structural requirement from Figma to prevent incorrect line breaks.
feedback.fixedCode:
// For '₹ 32,175'
<Text style={styles.basePrice}>
  <Text style={styles.currencySymbol}>{'₹ '}</Text>
  <Text style={styles.priceAmount}>32,175</Text>
</Text>

// For 'Add your landlord’s bank details...'
<Text style={styles.baseDescription}>
  <Text style={styles.regularPart}>{'Add your landlord’s '}</Text>
  <Text style={styles.highlightPart}>bank details</Text>
  <Text style={styles.regularPart}>{' to enable payouts'}</Text>
</Text>
